evidence.quote: Atlas Infinite includes 24 hours of continuous cloud backup at no additional cost.
Atlas meters backup hourly by the volume of uncompressed storage that your backups consume, measured in gigabyte-hours (GB-hours).

To preserve snapshots beyond that window, use the Additional Backup Retention setting, which Atlas enables by default. Additional backup retention incurs additional cost based on your backup policy and workload.
In the Atlas Administration API, the `backupEnabled` field controls Additional Backup Retention on an Atlas Infinite cluster.
